text: 0203 found K4 ahead of all ten scrambled copies in six cells of one family, where no copy led in more than one: outside the copies' range, which stops the queue until it is replicated.
The same search, unchanged, against forty fresh scrambled copies, with K4's rank in every cell and the counts split by row width.
K4 leads every copy in one cell only (A21, carried by rows of 9), as ten of the forty copies do in one or two. Chance; F6.21 closed. The plant is found.
